items.question: What is Farmio?
items.answer: Farmio is a digital agriculture platform providing smart farming solutions, crop monitoring and practical recommendations for growers.

items.question: Is Farmio available worldwide?
items.answer: We support UK farms first, with flexible tools that can be adapted for wider agricultural teams.

items.question: Does Farmio support sustainable farming?
items.answer: Yes. Our reports help reduce waste, protect soil health and use water and inputs more carefully.

items.question: How can I get started with Farmio?
items.answer: Contact our team, tell us about your farm and we will recommend a simple first setup.

items.question: What if I am not satisfied with the service?
items.answer: We keep support clear and responsive, and we will work with you to improve the setup.
